analysis.headline: Shares Your Data for Ads
analysis.quote: We may also share personal information (in the form of identifiers and internet activity information) with third party advertisers for purposes of targeting advertisements on non-Slack websites, applications, and services.

analysis.headline: Shares with Business Partners
analysis.quote: We may engage third-party companies or individuals as service providers or business partners to process Information and support our business.

analysis.headline: Shares with Corporate Affiliates
analysis.quote: Slack may share Information with our corporate affiliates, parents and/or subsidiaries.

analysis.headline: Workplace Spies on You
analysis.quote: Owners, administrators, Authorized Users, and other Customer representatives and personnel may be able to access, modify, or restrict access to Information. This may include, for example, your employer using features of the Services to access or modify your profile details, or to export logs of Workspace activity.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Location Data
analysis.quote: We receive information from you, our Customers and other third-parties that helps us approximate your location. We may, for example, use a business address submitted by your employer (who is our Customer) or an IP address received from your browser or device to determine approximate location to assist with localization or for security purposes.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Audio/Video Metadata
analysis.quote: Slack may receive, capture, and store metadata derived from your use of features such as Slack Huddles or Clips, and additional related data such as data regarding the date and time of your Slack Huddle and the Authorized User that you connected with.

analysis.headline: Cannot Opt Out Service Emails
analysis.quote: These communications are considered part of the Services and you may not opt out of them.

analysis.headline: Your Data Transferred Globally
analysis.quote: Slack may transfer your Personal Data to countries other than the one in which you live, including transfers to the United States.

analysis.headline: Retains Data After Account Deletion
analysis.quote: This may include keeping your Other Information after you have deactivated your account for the period of time needed for Slack to pursue legitimate business interests, conduct audits, comply with (and demonstrate compliance with) legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements.
